svg.title: You Build It, You Run It
svg.desc: You Build It, You Run It. The team that builds a service runs it in production, on call, so the people who can fix a problem hear about it first. Step 1, Thrown over the wall: Releases go over the wall: ops restart the leaking pods at 02:10 nightly; tickets bounce for days. Step 2, The team takes the pager: Payments runs what it builds: at 02:10 its on-call sees the leak began with 2.8.0 and rolls back. Step 3, Make on-call sustainable: Keep it sustainable: a shared rotation, under 2 pages a shift, a readiness review and time to fix. Step 4, Limits and pitfalls: Small teams, audit rules and deep specialisms need adapting; noisy, unfixed pages burn people out.
